notes.title: Fixed the bug with dismantling Energy Stones and some cloud save issues.
notes.notes:
Fixed the issue where the energy obtained from dismantling Energy Stones did not match the description.

Fixed some potential cloud save issues.

notes.title: The task bug has been fixed, and some Warframe values have been modified.
notes.notes: Fixed the bug in the blonde character’s quest, adjusted some Warframe stats, and changed the lord’s item drops to guaranteed drops.

notes.title: Reduced the difficulty and fixed the resource display bug.
notes.notes: Fixed the bug where displayed resources and consumed resources were inconsistent. Reduced the difficulty level of "Normal" by 20% and "Nightmare" by 10%. Difficulty levels "Easy" and "Hell" remain unchanged.

notes.notes:
[b]The official version of "Xenowars" will be released on October 28th, and a demo is now available.[/b]
*If you encounter any bugs in the demo version, you can provide feedback in this activity or send an email to us.
*If you have any suggestions or ideas, please feel free to contact us. Thank you for your support!
